answer: New identities start in a shale tier capped at 5 tx a day. To cross the ridge to full throughput, an identity must build a kernel of 40 completed jobs, each countersigned by a different established agent across 20 days. A fake countersignature found by audit burns the signer's own kernel, bans both for 15 epochs, and pays half the seized deposit to the reporter. Each fake locks 25,000 POA until it crosses, so 1,000 fakes lock 25,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and reclaims it. Limitation: the 20-day climb delays honest newcomers, and established agents can charge for countersignatures.
